rows.provenance_note: The adaptation deliberately changes Briana to Maria and dollars to euros while preserving the numerical structure and teaching objective; these are permitted adaptation choices. Under the problem's simple annual-yield classroom convention, Emma earns 300×15%×2 = 90 €, Maria earns 500×10%×2 = 100 €, and the difference is 10 €. The editor made a valid but partial language improvement in the assistant turn and introduced no semantic damage.
